name: AN-0103 Survey on the Measurement and Assessment of Sustainability Literacy R2.docx
text:
Dear Stakeholder,
The following survey has been developed by the Sustainability Office Coordination Unit of Gebze Technical University to measure and assess the knowledge, awareness, and sustainability literacy levels of our academic and administrative staff.
Your responses, comments, and feedback will contribute to the continuous improvement of our sustainability initiatives and enable us to provide more effective services. Your valuable contributions are of great importance in informing and shaping our future activities and initiatives in the field of sustainability .
We kindly remind you that you can submit any additional requests through the tys.gtu.edu.tr system and thank you for your interest and valuable contributions.

QUESTIONS:
How aware are you of the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)?
I know all the 17 goals in detail
I am generally aware of these goals
I don't have any information about the goals
How many hours in total have you spent on a sustainability-related activity in the last year?
More than 10 hours
5-10 hours
0-5 hours
How many of the definitions such as “water footprint”, “carbon footprint”, “carbon credit”, “ecological footprint”, “environmental label”, “circular economy” do you have information about?
4-6
2-4
0-2
Which of the following behaviors do you think contributes more to achieving environmental sustainability goals?
A) Recycling and waste reduction
B) Energy-saving
C) Sustainable transportation options
How sensitive are you to adopting practices and behaviors (energy and water saving, etc.) that will contribute to sustainability in your daily life?
A) I'm very careful
B) I pay attention but often forget
C) I'm not at all interested
Which aspect of sustainability do you think is more on the agenda globally?
A) Mitigating climate change
B) Conservation of biodiversity
C) Social equality and justice
D) Protection of water resources
E) Zero Faste
F) Energy Efficiency
Do you think universities should play an active role in supporting students' sustainability awareness?
A) Absolutely agree
B) Agree
C) Disagree
Do you think all college students should take a required course on sustainability?
A) Yes, it should be mandatory
B) No, it should be optional
C) There is no need to take such a lesson
Are you actively involved in any sustainability-related projects or initiatives on your campus or in your community?
Yes, I am actively involved
No, but I'm interested in joining
No, I am not interested in
If you are actively involved in any project or initiative related to sustainability on your campus or in your community, please write the subject of the project or initiative.
………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………..
What role do you think the university should play in addressing water scarcity issues in the local community?
A) Society should actively participate in water saving projects
B) Training workshops on water saving should be organized
C) Develop sustainable water management plans in cooperation with local authorities and organizations
D) The university should not have a role in this matter, this is the responsibility of local governments
Do you find the activities (seminars, symposiums and other events) and practices (applications and projects for clean energy and energy saving, eco system and recycling, digital technologies, etc.) carried out at our university on sustainability sufficient?
A) Activities and practices are sufficient
B) Activities are sufficient, practices are insufficient
C) Activities are insufficient, practices are sufficient
D) Both are inadequate
E) I have no information
What do you think should be done at a university to become a sustainable campus?
